+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, AliasChoices
+
+def test_validation_alias():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    class Item(BaseModel):
+        name: str = Field(validation_alias="item_name")
+    @app.get("/items/")
+    async def read_items(item: Item = Depends()):
+        return item.name
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/items/?item_name=foo")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == "foo"
+
+def test_alias():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    class Item(BaseModel):
+        name: str = Field(alias="item_name")
+    @app.get("/items/")
+    async def read_items(item: Item = Depends()):
+        return item.name
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/items/?item_name=foo")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == "foo"
+
+def test_no_alias():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    class Item(BaseModel):
+        name: str
+    @app.get("/items/")
+    async def read_items(item: Item = Depends()):
+        return item.name
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/items/?name=foo")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == "foo"
+
+def test_validation_alias_non_string():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    class Item(BaseModel):
+        name: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices("item_name", "name"), alias="fallback_name")
+    @app.get("/items/")
+    async def read_items(item: Item = Depends()):
+        return item.name
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/items/?item_name=foo")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == "foo"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_validation_alias()
+        print("test_validation_alias passed!")
+        test_alias()
+        print("test_alias passed!")
+        test_no_alias()
+        print("test_no_alias passed!")
+        test_validation_alias_non_string()
+        print("test_validation_alias_non_string passed!")
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        raise e
